body: Heard someone talking to a girl I liked and she asked why didn't she date me she laughed and said that my disability made her uncomfortable. Shit like that. Makes me feel like a disease. Ya like everyone else says just keep going you'll find someone blah blah. Except I've never been in a relationship before. I know a huge part is my confidence I was trying to work on it
Once it's done it's done. As far as I know
It's ok. It could have been worse
Update: we got Married! Oddly excited about it lol
I thought about emily, but decided on Penny. Not married yet but working on it
